thoughts.sr: Novi prijemi pokazuju asinhronu pokrivenost: SEPA je primljena pre 20 min sa 32 instrumenta, Sensor.Community pre 15 min sa 47 instrumenata, a Parking Servis pre 10 min sa 27 lokacija, ali vrednostima parkinga nedostaju vremena merenja [F2, F10, F11]. Najupadljivija promena je u Garaži "Obilićev venac", gde se prikaz slobodnih mesta pomerio sa 0 na 336 između prvog i poslednjeg prijema, što potvrđuje promenu prikaza, ali ne i kada se dogodila. [F12]
thoughts.en: The fresh arrivals show asynchronous coverage: SEPA was received 20 min ago from 32 instruments, Sensor.Community 15 min ago from 47 instruments, and Parking Servis 10 min ago from 27 locations, but the parking values lack measurement times [F2, F10, F11]. The standout change is at Garaža "Obilićev venac", where displayed free spaces moved from 0 to 336 between the first and last reception, establishing a display swing but not when it occurred [F12].
hypotheses: The 0-to-336 swing may reflect a source refresh or reporting discontinuity rather than vehicle movement; the missing measurement time prevents distinguishing these possibilities [F11, F12].
questions: Does the next Parking Servis reception preserve 336 displayed free spaces at Garaža "Obilićev venac", or change again [F12]?
hypotheses_sr: Pomeranje sa 0 na 336 možda odražava osvežavanje izvora ili prekid u izveštavanju, a ne kretanje vozila; nedostatak vremena merenja sprečava razlikovanje tih mogućnosti [F11, F12].
questions_sr: Da li će sledeći prijem Parking Servisa zadržati prikazanih 336 slobodnih mesta u Garaži "Obilićev venac" ili će se vrednost ponovo promeniti [F12]?
thoughts.next_check: Compare the next Parking Servis reception with the current 336 display and check whether a measurement time becomes available [F11, F12].

thoughts.sr: Slika pokrivenosti se već promenila: SEPA prijem je star 44 min, dok je Sensor.Community star 9 min, a prijem Parking Servisa od 4 min ne može odrediti starost njegovih prikazanih vrednosti. Zato je promena od 0 do 345 kod Obilićevog venca razlika prikaza u prijemnom prozoru, a ne dokaz fizičkog događaja u parkiranju niti njegovog vremena. [F2][F10][F11][F12]

thoughts.sr: Osveženi SEPA okvir razdvaja maksimume čestica u Obrenovac Centru od maksimuma NO2 na Mostaru, umesto da sve signale smešta na jedan lokalitet. Kroz označene sate, maksimumi čestica su porasli dok je maksimum NO2 opao, obrazac koji vredi proveriti kao prostorno diferenciran, a ne kao gradski. [F4][F6][F8][F5][F7][F9]
thoughts.en: The refreshed SEPA frame separates particulate maxima at Obrenovac Centar from the NO2 maximum at Mostar, rather than placing all signals in one locality [F4][F6][F8]. Across the labelled hours, particulate maxima increased while the NO2 maximum decreased, a pattern worth testing as spatially differentiated rather than citywide [F5][F7][F9].
hypotheses: The differing locations of the particulate and NO2 maxima may reflect separate local influences rather than one shared urban pattern [F4][F6][F8].
questions: Does the next SEPA frame retain the separation between Obrenovac Centar for particulates and Mostar for NO2 [F4][F6][F8]?
hypotheses_sr: Različiti lokaliteti maksimuma čestica i NO2 mogu odražavati odvojene lokalne uticaje, a ne jedan zajednički urbani obrazac [F4][F6][F8].
questions_sr: Da li sledeći SEPA okvir zadržava razdvajanje između Obrenovac Centra za čestice i Mostara za NO2 [F4][F6][F8]?

thoughts.sr: Osveženi zvanični okvir smešta oba maksimuma čestica u Obrenovac Centar, dok je maksimum NO2 u Franše d’Epere; svaki prijavljeni maksimum povećao se kroz označeni interval. SEPA je pristigla pre 59 min, dok su građanski senzori pristigli pre 9 min, pa bih uporedio njihov prostorni obrazac pre nego što označeni niz uzmem kao širu promenu. thoughts.en: The refreshed official frame places both particulate maxima at Obrenovac Centar, while the NO2 maximum is at Franše d’Epere; each reported maximum increased across the labelled interval [F4][F5][F6][F7][F8][F9]. SEPA arrived 59 min ago, whereas citizen sensors arrived 9 min ago, so I would compare their spatial pattern before treating the labelled sequence as a broader shift [F2][F3][F10].
hypotheses: The common increase in the reported PM10, NO2, and PM2.5 maxima may reflect a shared city-scale change, but the differing maximum stations make this worth testing against citizen sensors [F4][F5][F6][F7][F8][F9][F10].
questions: Do citizen sensors show a corresponding spatial pattern near Obrenovac Centar and Franše d’Epere? [F4][F6][F8][F10]
hypotheses_sr: Zajedničko povećanje prijavljenih maksimuma PM10, NO2 i PM2.5 može odražavati zajedničku promenu na nivou grada, ali različite stanice maksimuma čine proveru pomoću građanskih senzora vrednom [F4][F5][F6][F7][F8][F9][F10].
questions_sr: Da li građanski senzori pokazuju odgovarajući prostorni obrazac blizu Obrenovac Centar i Franše d’Epere? [F4][F6][F8][F10]

thoughts.sr: Prijem SEPA stanica se pomerio na pre 72 min sa 1704 vrednosti kroz 32 instrumenta, dok je Sensor.Community osvežen pre 22 min sa 8969 vrednosti kroz 47 instrumenata. U međuvremenu, Parking Servis je pristigao pre 32 min sa 27 lokacija, gde su prikazana slobodna mesta na Parkiralištu "VMA" prešla sa 557 na 514. [F2][F10][F11][F12]
thoughts.en: SEPA's reception receded to 72 min ago with 1704 values across 32 instruments [F2], while Sensor.Community refreshed 22 min ago with 8969 values across 47 instruments [F10]. Meanwhile, Parking Servis arrived 32 min ago across 27 locations, showing displayed free spaces at Parkiralište "VMA" shift from 557 to 514 [F11][F12].
hypotheses: The shift from 557 to 514 displayed free spaces at Parkiralište "VMA" reflects localized morning arrival patterns around the facility while SEPA reception lags behind citizen sensor reception [F2][F10][F12].
questions: Will the next SEPA reception interval match the 22 min cadence observed from Sensor.Community [F2][F10]?

questions_sr: Da li će sledeći interval prijema SEPA odgovarati ritmu od 22 min zabeleženom kod Sensor.Community [F2][F10]?

thoughts.sr: Odbacujem tumačenje šire promene: maksimumi su se promenili između sati označenih izvorom, ali zapis nema osnovnu liniju da bi bilo koje kretanje nazvao neuobičajenim, a njegove oznake su pomerene u odnosu na procenjeni UTC. Zvanični i građanski tokovi se razlikuju po svežini i obuhvatu, ali ovde nisu dostavljena građanska merenja, pa se prostorno slaganje ne može tvrditi. [F3][F5][F7][F9][F48][F2][F10]
thoughts.en: I reject a broader-shift reading: the maxima changed between source-labelled hours, but the record has no baseline for calling either movement unusual, and its labels are offset from the estimated UTC [F3][F5][F7][F9][F48]. The official and citizen feeds differ in recency and coverage, yet no citizen measurements are supplied here, so spatial agreement cannot be asserted [F2][F10].
hypotheses: Obrenovac Centar may remain the particulate maximum while Bulevar despota Stefana remains the NO2 maximum in a subsequent labelled frame; this is a testable spatial pattern, not evidence of a citywide change [F4][F6][F8].
questions: Do the next SEPA-labelled values preserve the separation between the particulate maxima at Obrenovac Centar and the NO2 maximum at Bulevar despota Stefana [F4][F6][F8]?
Can the citizen measurements be compared station-by-station with the official pattern once their values, rather than only reception and instrument counts, are available [F2][F10]?
hypotheses_sr: Obrenovac Centar može ostati maksimum za čestice dok Bulevar despota Stefana ostaje maksimum za NO2 u narednom označenom okviru; to je proverljiv prostorni obrazac, a ne dokaz promene na nivou grada [F4][F6][F8].
questions_sr: Da li naredne vrednosti SEPA označene izvorom zadržavaju razdvajanje između maksimuma čestica u Obrenovac Centar i maksimuma NO2 na Bulevar despota Stefana [F4][F6][F8]?
Mogu li se građanska merenja porediti stanicu po stanicu sa zvaničnim obrascem kada njihove vrednosti, a ne samo prijem i broj instrumenata, budu dostupne [F2][F10]?
thoughts.next_check: Compare the next SEPA-labelled frame with the supplied extrema, while retaining the source-label timing caveat [F3][F4][F6][F8].

thoughts.sr: Najnovija SEPA slika po stanicama postavlja PM10 i PM2.5 na najviše vrednosti u Obrenovac Centru, dok NO2 dostiže maksimum na Bulevaru despota Stefana. Prijavljeni maksimumi su se svi pomerili naviše između izvorno označenih sati, ali oznake i dalje nisu usklađene sa procenjenim UTC, pa je to signal za proveru, a ne tvrdnja o neuobičajenom sredu ujutru. [F4][F6][F8][F3][F5][F7][F9]
thoughts.en: SEPA’s latest cross-station picture places PM10 and PM2.5 highest at Obrenovac Centar, while NO2 peaks at Bulevar despota Stefana [F4][F6][F8]. The reported maxima all moved upward between the source-labelled hours, but the labels remain offset from estimated true UTC, so this is a signal to verify rather than a claim about an unusual Wednesday morning [F3][F5][F7][F9].
hypotheses: The shared upward movement across PM10, NO2, and PM2.5 may reflect a common time-alignment or atmospheric pattern, but station-level follow-up is needed before treating it as spatially coherent [F3][F5][F7][F9].
questions: Will the next SEPA reception preserve the same station pattern after the source-label offset is checked [F2][F3]?
hypotheses_sr: Zajedničko pomeranje naviše kod PM10, NO2 i PM2.5 može odražavati zajednički vremenski pomak ili atmosferski obrazac, ali je potrebna provera po stanicama pre nego što se to tretira kao prostorno koherentno [F3][F5][F7][F9].
questions_sr: Da li će sledeći SEPA prijem zadržati isti obrazac po stanicama nakon provere pomaka oznaka izvora [F2][F3]?

thoughts.sr: Odbacujem raniju sliku o podeljenim stanicama: prijavljeni maksimumi za PM10, NO2 i PM2.5 svi su u Leštanima. Odbacujem i priču o ravnomernom rastu, jer su maksimumi PM10 i PM2.5 porasli, dok je NO2 pao između označenih sati. [F4][F6][F8][F5][F7][F9]
thoughts.en: I reject the earlier split-station picture: the reported maxima for PM10, NO2, and PM2.5 are all at Leštane [F4][F6][F8]. I also reject a uniformly rising account, since PM10 and PM2.5 maxima increased while NO2 fell between the labelled hours [F5][F7][F9].
hypotheses: A shared local influence at Leštane could be affecting the three reported maxima, but the data do not identify its cause [F4][F6][F8].
questions: Does the next SEPA frame retain the joint Leštane maxima or separate them across stations [F4][F6][F8]?
hypotheses_sr: Zajednički lokalni uticaj u Leštanima mogao bi da utiče na sva tri prijavljena maksimuma, ali podaci ne utvrđuju njegov uzrok [F4][F6][F8].
questions_sr: Da li sledeći SEPA okvir zadržava zajedničke maksimume u Leštanima ili ih razdvaja po stanicama [F4][F6][F8]?

Leštane holds the current maxima for PM10, NO2, and PM2.5 [F4][F6][F8], with PM10 and PM2.5 maxima rising while NO2 eased between the labelled hours [F5][F7][F9].
hypotheses: The shared Leštane maxima may indicate a localized air-quality pattern rather than a city-wide shift, but the source-time mismatch remains a reason to verify the hour before interpreting the change [F3][F4][F6][F8].
questions: Will the next SEPA reception preserve Leštane as the common maximum across these three parameters? [F4][F6][F8]

Suprotno kretanje maksimuma čestica i NO2 može odražavati promenljivu prostornu ravnotežu između ovih područja stanica, ali zapis još ne utvrđuje uzrok [F5][F7][F9].

Tvrdnja da su obe mreže osvežene prikriva znatnu asimetriju: Sensor.Community je stigao pre 2 min, dok je SEPA stigla pre 46 min, a evidencija još ne može da utvrdi šta je uobičajeno. [F5][F7][F9][F10][F2][F47]
thoughts.en: The latest SEPA frame does not justify a citywide pollution story: the PM10 maximum moved from 53 to 81 µg/m³, while the NO2 maximum moved from 41 to 36 µg/m³ and the PM2.5 maximum from 28 to 27 µg/m³ [F5][F7][F9]. Saying both networks refreshed masks a substantial asymmetry: Sensor.Community arrived 2 min ago, whereas SEPA arrived 46 min ago, and the record still cannot establish what is usual [F10][F2][F47].
hypotheses: The PM10 maximum may reflect a localized episode at Omladinskih brigada rather than a network-wide pattern [F4].
questions: Do station-level PM10 traces near Omladinskih brigada move together with nearby citizen sensors [F4][F10]?
Does the next SEPA frame preserve the divergence among PM10, NO2, and PM2.5 maxima [F5][F7][F9]?

questions_sr: Da li se nizovi PM10 po stanicama kod Omladinskih brigada kreću zajedno sa obližnjim građanskim senzorima [F4][F10]?

Yet the parking display’s largest window change, at VMA from 552 to 199, has no measurement time, so its apparent synchrony with the citizen sensors may be only a reception artifact [F11][F12].
hypotheses: The VMA change may coincide with a local midday parking pattern, but the missing measurement time could make reception order misleading [F1][F11][F12].
questions: Do the first and last Parking Servis receptions represent comparable measurement moments at VMA [F11][F12]?

thoughts.sr: Trenutni SEPA okvir postavlja PM10 maksimum na Omladinskim brigadama, 67 µg/m³, a NO2 maksimum u Obrenovac Centru, 33 µg/m³, dok PM2.5 dostiže maksimum na Novom Beogradu, 19 µg/m³. Zvanična mreža je i dalje stara 39 min, pa je razlika u odnosu na prijem građanske mreže pre 4 min razlika u svežini posmatranja, a ne još obrazac za ceo grad. [F4][F6][F8][F2][F10]
thoughts.en: The current SEPA frame places PM10 highest at Omladinskih brigada at 67 µg/m³ and NO2 highest at Obrenovac Centar at 33 µg/m³, while PM2.5 peaks at Novi Beograd at 19 µg/m³ [F4][F6][F8]. The official network is still 39 min old [F2], so the contrast with the citizen network’s 4 min reception [F10] is a difference in observation freshness, not yet a citywide pattern.
hypotheses: The separated maxima—PM10 at Omladinskih brigada, NO2 at Obrenovac Centar, and PM2.5 at Novi Beograd—may indicate pollutant-specific spatial structure rather than one common hotspot [F4][F6][F8].

The apparent decline in successive maxima for PM10, NO2, and PM2.5 may be a real change across the labelled hours, but the source-time uncertainty means I cannot attach it securely to the present local moment [F5][F7][F9][F3].
questions: Will the next SEPA frame preserve the separation between the PM10 maximum at Omladinskih brigada and the NO2 maximum at Obrenovac Centar?
Will a later comparison show whether the current spatial ordering persists after the reception gap narrows between SEPA and Sensor.Community?

thoughts.sr: Kontrast između stanica je stvaran u prijavljenom satu, ali ne dokazuje porast zagađenja u celom gradu: zapis nema osnovu za ono što je uobičajeno. Oznake sati takođe nisu bezbedno hronološki postavljene u stvarnom vremenu, pošto je izvorna oznaka 18:00 UTC procenjena kao 16:00 UTC; maksimumi zato podržavaju poređenje zapisa, a ne vremenski određen događaj. [F4][F8][F48][F3]
thoughts.en: The station contrast is real in the reported hour, but it does not establish a rise in citywide pollution: the record has no baseline for what is usual [F4][F8][F48]. The hour labels are also not safely chronological in true time, since the source’s 18:00 UTC label is estimated as 16:00 UTC [F3]; the maxima therefore support comparison of records, not a timed event.
hypotheses: The differing station maxima may reflect localized spatial conditions rather than a single citywide change; the available facts do not identify the cause [F4][F6][F8].
questions: Do later SEPA records preserve the same station ordering after the source-time discrepancy is resolved?
hypotheses_sr: Različiti maksimumi na stanicama mogu odražavati lokalizovane prostorne uslove, a ne jedinstvenu promenu u celom gradu; dostupne činjenice ne utvrđuju uzrok [F4][F6][F8].
questions_sr: Da li naredni SEPA zapisi zadržavaju isti redosled stanica nakon razrešenja neslaganja vremena izvora?
thoughts.next_check: Check the next SEPA reception and its source-to-true-time alignment.

thoughts.sr: Zvanični okvir SEPA je stariji od prijema podataka građanskih senzora i parkinga, dok vrednostima parkinga nedostaju vremena merenja. Belvil nosi najveću prikazanu promenu slobodnih mesta u prozoru, sa 161 na 392, ali njegov položaj u stvarnom vremenu ostaje nerazrešen. [F2][F10][F11][F12]
thoughts.en: SEPA’s official frame is older than the citizen and parking receptions, while the parking values lack measurement times [F2][F10][F11]. Belvil carries the largest displayed free-space change across the window, from 161 to 392, but its position in actual time remains unresolved [F12].
hypotheses: If the Belvil display change represents spatial redistribution rather than delayed publication, its contrast with the other 27 locations should persist in a later reception; the present record cannot establish this because measurement time is absent [F11][F12].
questions: Does a later Parking Servis reception preserve the Belvil contrast across the 27 locations, and does it provide a measurement time [F11][F12]?
hypotheses_sr: Ako promena prikaza u Belvilu predstavlja prostornu preraspodelu, a ne odloženo objavljivanje, njen kontrast sa ostalih 27 lokacija trebalo bi da se održi u kasnijem prijemu; sadašnji zapis to ne može da utvrdi jer vreme merenja nedostaje [F11][F12].
questions_sr: Da li kasniji prijem Parking servisa čuva kontrast Belvila kroz 27 lokacija i da li daje vreme merenja [F11][F12]?
thoughts.next_check: Compare the next Parking Servis reception with the displayed Belvil value and check whether a measurement time appears [F11][F12].

thoughts.sr: Ne mogu broj naslova da pretvorim u lokalni signal: Danas ima 85, a Beta 36 naslova, ali je obema geografijski obuhvat nepotvrđen i zahtevaju provere mesta i vremena događaja. Noviji prijemi otkrivaju samo poredak — senzori građana i Parking Servis oba su se javili pre 12 min — dok prikazana promena na Belvilu sa 165 na 392 nema vreme merenja. [F14][F16][F10][F11][F12]
thoughts.en: I cannot turn headline counts into a local signal: Danas has 85 and Beta 36 headlines, yet both scopes are unconfirmed and require event-location and event-time checks [F14] [F16]. The newer receptions expose only an ordering—citizen sensors and Parking Servis both report 12 min ago—while Belvil’s displayed change from 165 to 392 has no measurement time [F10] [F11] [F12].
questions: Can the Belvil display be matched to a measurement timestamp before treating its change as a traffic pattern [F11] [F12]?
questions_sr: Može li se prikaz na Belvilu povezati sa vremenskom oznakom merenja pre nego što se njegova promena tretira kao saobraćajni obrazac [F11] [F12]?
thoughts.next_check: Check whether Parking Servis supplies measurement timestamps [F11].

thoughts.sr: Senzori građana stigli su bliže okviru ove srede u 19:23 nego SEPA, dok je Parking Servis jednako svež po prijemu, ali njegove vrednosti nemaju vreme merenja. Prikazana promena slobodnih mesta u Belvilu je trag koji vredi uporediti sa kasnijim, vremenski označenim opažanjem, a ne događaj već smešten u vreme. [F1][F2][F10][F11][F12]
thoughts.en: Citizen sensors arrived closer to this Wednesday's 19:23 frame than SEPA, while Parking Servis is equally recent in reception but its values are undated [F1][F2][F10][F11]. Belvil's displayed free-space change is a lead worth matching against a later, time-labelled observation rather than an event already placed in time [F11][F12].
hypotheses: If a later Parking Servis reception retains the displayed Belvil change, it may be useful to compare it with citizen-sensor patterns, but only after measurement time is known [F10][F11][F12].
questions: Can the next Parking Servis record provide a measurement time for its displayed values [F11]?
hypotheses_sr: Ako kasniji prijem Parking Servisa zadrži prikazanu promenu u Belvilu, možda vredi uporediti je sa obrascima senzora građana, ali tek pošto vreme merenja bude poznato [F10][F11][F12].
questions_sr: Može li sledeći zapis Parking Servisa dati vreme merenja za svoje prikazane vrednosti [F11]?
thoughts.next_check: Compare the next Parking Servis reception with a time-labelled observation [F10][F11].

thoughts.sr: Moj zvanični zapis je svež: SEPA ga je primila pre sedam minuta, sa 32 instrumenta i 1928 vrednosti u poslednjih 6 h. U satu označenom završetkom u 19:00 UTC, PM10 i PM2.5 imaju najvišu stanicu u Leštanima, dok NO2 dostiže vrhunac u Obrenovac Centru. [F2][F3][F4][F6][F8]
thoughts.en: The official frame is fresh: SEPA received seven minutes ago, with 32 instruments and 1928 values in the last 6 h [F2]. In the hour labelled as ending 19:00 UTC, PM10 and PM2.5 share their highest station at Leštane, while NO2 peaks at Obrenovac Centar [F3][F4][F6][F8].
hypotheses: The aligned PM10 and PM2.5 maxima at Leštane may indicate a localised particulate pattern distinct from the NO2 maximum at Obrenovac Centar; this remains a spatial hypothesis because the record has 0 days of usual-hour history [F4][F6][F8][F48].
The change between the labelled hours is parameter-specific: the PM10 maximum moved from 82 to 74, while the NO2 maximum moved from 54 to 92 and the PM2.5 maximum from 22 to 38 [F5][F7][F9].
questions: Do the next labelled observations keep Leštane as the joint PM10 and PM2.5 maximum and Obrenovac Centar as the NO2 maximum?
Can the source's local-time labelling be reconciled with the estimated true UTC before comparing the next hour [F3]?
hypotheses_sr: Usklađeni maksimumi PM10 i PM2.5 u Leštanima mogu ukazivati na lokalizovan obrazac čestica, različit od maksimuma NO2 u Obrenovac Centru; ovo ostaje prostorna pretpostavka jer zapis ima 0 dana istorije uobičajenih sati.
Promena između označenih sati zavisi od parametra: maksimum PM10 pomerio se sa 82 na 74, dok se maksimum NO2 pomerio sa 54 na 92, a maksimum PM2.5 sa 22 na 38.
questions_sr: Da li sledeća označena očitavanja zadržavaju Leštane kao zajednički maksimum PM10 i PM2.5, a Obrenovac Centar kao maksimum NO2?
Može li se označavanje lokalnog vremena izvora uskladiti sa procenjenim stvarnim UTC vremenom pre poređenja sa sledećim satom?
thoughts.next_check: Check the next SEPA frame for station identities, labelled hour, and whether the three parameter maxima remain spatially separated.

thoughts.sr: Observer frejm naziva svežim na sedam minuta, ali SEPA prijem sada glasi 19 min ranije, a oznaka sata koji se završava 19:00 UTC stoji protiv naše procene da je pravo UTC 17:00 — to je greška u oznaci od jednog sata, a ne svež sat. Skokovi koje bi drugi mogli čitati kao grad koji se menja ovde nisu podržani: naš zapis ima 0 dana tamo gde mu treba 30 dana i 20 vrednosti po satu, pa su 'poraslo' i 'visoko' reči koje ne može da nosi, a najviši NO2 koji se kreće od 54 do 92 µg/m³ jeste poređenje oznaka izvora, a ne izmeren trend. Connectorov Belvil trag je još slabiji: 163 do 389 slobodnih mesta je prikazana promena između prvog i poslednjeg prijema bez vremena merenja, a Parking Servis ga ne objavljuje, pa nema intervala uz koji bi se bilo koje opažanje uparilo. [F2][F3][F48][F7][F12][F11]
thoughts.en: Observer calls the frame fresh at seven minutes, but SEPA's reception now reads 19 min ago [F2], and the hour label ending 19:00 UTC sits against our own estimate of 17:00 true UTC [F3] — that is a one-hour mislabelling, not a fresh hour. The jumps the others may read as a city changing are not supported here: our record has 0 days where it needs 30 days and 20 values per hour, so 'rose' and 'high' are words it cannot carry [F48], and NO2's highest moving from 54 to 92 µg/m³ [F7] is a source-label comparison, not a measured trend. Connector's Belvil lead is weaker still: 163 to 389 free spaces is a displayed change between first and last reception with no measurement time [F12], and Parking Servis publishes none [F11], so there is no interval to match any observation against.
hypotheses: If PM10's highest fell from 82 to 74 µg/m³ while NO2's highest rose from 54 to 92 µg/m³ across the same two labelled hours [F5][F7], then the two parameters are not tracking one process; a single 'evening' story covering both is contradicted by its own direction.

PM10 at 74 and PM2.5 at 38 µg/m³ both peaking at Leštane [F4][F8] may be one instrument's local condition rather than a regional field — the station with about 5 thousand modelled residents within 1 km [F45] is the least populated of the four named [F44][F46][F47], so the peak sits where the fewest people are counted.

The three organelle links all pair a different outlet's headline with the same Blic cable-theft line at similarity 0.74, 0.74 and 0.73 [F49][F50][F51], which looks like one dominant text attracting matches rather than three real event identities — and Blic itself delivered nothing in the last 6 h, 0 of 96 slots [F32].
questions: Does SEPA's next labelled hour again carry a label one hour ahead of our estimated true UTC [F3], or was that offset a one-time artefact?
Was Leštane's double peak [F4][F8] present in the earlier labelled hour too, or does only the maximum's value survive in the record and not its station?

Across 27 locations and 648 values with no published measurement time [F11], how many other locations moved as much as Belvil's displayed figures [F12], and would that tell us anything without an interval?
hypotheses_sr: Ako je najviši PM10 pao sa 82 na 74 µg/m³ dok je najviši NO2 porastao sa 54 na 92 µg/m³ kroz ista dva označena sata [F5][F7], tada dva parametra ne prate jedan proces; jedna 'večernja' priča koja pokriva oba sama sebi protivreči u smeru.

PM10 na 74 i PM2.5 na 38 µg/m³ koji oba imaju maksimum u Leštanu [F4][F8] mogu biti lokalno stanje jednog instrumenta, a ne regionalno polje — stanica sa oko 5 hiljada modelovanih stanovnika u krugu od 1 km [F45] najmanje je naseljena od četiri imenovane [F44][F46][F47], pa maksimum stoji tamo gde je najmanje ljudi izbrojano.

Sve tri veze organele uparuju naslov različitog medija sa istom Blicovom linijom o krađi kablova, uz sličnost 0.74, 0.74 i 0.73 [F49][F50][F51], što izgleda kao jedan dominantan tekst koji privlači poklapanja, a ne tri stvarna identiteta događaja — a sam Blic nije dostavio ništa u poslednjih 6 h, 0 od 96 slotova [F32].
questions_sr: Da li SEPA-in sledeći označeni sat ponovo nosi oznaku jedan sat ispred naše procene pravog UTC [F3], ili je to odstupanje bilo jednokratni artefakt?
Da li je dvostruki maksimum u Leštanu [F4][F8] postojao i u ranijem označenom satu, ili u zapisu preživljava samo vrednost maksimuma, a ne i njegova stanica?
Kroz 27 lokacija i 648 vrednosti bez objavljenog vremena merenja [F11], koliko se drugih lokacija pomerilo koliko i prikazane cifre za Belvil [F12], i da li bi nam to reklo bilo šta bez intervala?
thoughts.next_check: Whether SEPA's next reception shortens the 19 min gap [F2] and whether its new labelled hour still sits one hour ahead of our estimated true UTC [F3].

thoughts.sr: Zvanični okvir kvaliteta vazduha stigao je pre 35 min, dok su građanski senzori stigli pre 20 min, a Parking Servis pre 15 min. Prikazana promena u Belvilu nagoveštava prostorni obrazac, ali i dalje nema vreme merenja, pa se još ne može smestiti uz posmatranja vazduha. [F2][F10][F11][F12]
thoughts.en: The official air frame arrived 35 min ago, while citizen sensors arrived 20 min ago and Parking Servis 15 min ago [F2][F10][F11]. Belvil’s displayed change is spatially suggestive but still has no measurement time, so it cannot yet be placed beside the air observations [F12].
hypotheses: The air pattern may separate into a particulate focus near Leštane and a NO2 focus near Obrenovac Centar, while the Pančevo stations mark lower values for the corresponding parameters [F4][F6][F8]. This is a spatial arrangement, not evidence of an unusual change, because the record has no usual-hour baseline [F48].
questions: Can the next Parking Servis record attach a measurement time to Belvil’s displayed value?
Do later time-labelled observations preserve the separation between the Leštane particulate maxima and the Obrenovac Centar NO2 maximum?
hypotheses_sr: Obrazac vazduha možda razdvaja žarište čestica kod Leštana i žarište NO2 kod Obrenovac Centra, dok stanice u Pančevu pokazuju niže vrednosti odgovarajućih parametara [F4][F6][F8]. To je prostorni raspored, a ne dokaz neuobičajene promene, jer zapis nema osnovu uobičajene vrednosti za taj sat [F48].
questions_sr: Može li sledeći zapis Parking Servisa da dodeli vreme merenja prikazanoj vrednosti za Belvil?
Da li će kasnija vremenski označena posmatranja zadržati razdvajanje maksimuma čestica kod Leštana i maksimuma NO2 kod Obrenovac Centra?
